<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Terrifying Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5501) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Visual" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=727" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature

</column>

---

Your flesh tears and warps as you transform. Attempt [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) each enemy within 30 feet. This Demoralize loses the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) trait and gains the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) trait, and you don't take a penalty if a creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each creature is temporarily immune to Terrifying Transformation for 1 minute.
name: Terrifying Transformation
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
